name: The Touch of Zanzil
summary: Doc Mixilpixil examines you and seeks a cause for your alarming condition. He asks to draw blood before consulting his colleagues about a cure.

sections.title: The examination
sections.body: Doc Mixilpixil thinks you look worse than death and says he needs a blood sample to help you. You can lie down for his examination, though his warning suggests the treatment may hurt. Once he has examined you, he calls Dr. Montgomery and Mr. Noarm to confer about your case.

faq.answer: Doc Mixilpixil examines you and asks to draw blood so he can look for the cause of your condition.

faq.q: Why does Doc Mixilpixil want my blood?
faq.answer: Doc Mixilpixil says he needs a blood sample to find the cause and help you.

faq.q: Who are Dr. Montgomery and Mr. Noarm?
faq.answer: Dr. Montgomery and Mr. Noarm are Doc Mixilpixil's colleagues, whom he calls to confer about your case.
After examining you, Doc Mixilpixil calls Dr. Montgomery and Mr. Noarm to confer.
